archetypes.name: dyn-step2-routing
archetypes.rationale: Step 2b now relies on a single action directive across all terminal branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 2b drafter routing in python/larch/design/design_lifecycle.py. Verify every zero-exit branch emits exactly one trusted DRAFTER_NEXT_ACTION and every non-zero branch avoids the delimiter/action row. Pay special attention to rc10 inline retry, rc11 pause, rc12/rc13 sidecars, dirty-tree recovery, and structural fallback. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-pause-gating
archetypes.rationale: Pause-save ownership moved from shared postplan into caller-specific gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the pause-save capture and PAUSE_OK gating changes. Confirm pre-drafter pause, drafter-internal rc11, and retained terminal postplan rc11 preserve diagnostics, do not duplicate POSTPLAN rows, and never emit trusted drafter actions after PAUSE_OK=false or missing PAUSE_OK. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-skill-contract
archetypes.rationale: The prompt contract changed from row slicing to DRAFTER_NEXT_ACTION dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check skills/design/SKILL.md and the related reference files against the new wrapper contract. Verify prompt-side prose treats non-zero drafter exits as hard aborts, dispatches only from DRAFTER_NEXT_ACTION on exit 0, and keeps retained design-step2b-postplan.sh use scoped to inline fallback, inline retry, and failsafe follow-ons. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
